description: The drafting-partner agent alerts the author and recommends research-librarian when evidence is needed before a drafting run begins; the author invokes nfs-research, which invokes research-librarian.

cases.given: drafting-partner is invoked for a chapter and the evidence log lacks entries for the chapter topic
cases.expect: drafting-partner alerts the author and recommends research-librarian; the author invokes nfs-research to gather evidence before the drafting run begins

cases.given: drafting-partner determines that source coverage is insufficient for the planned argument
cases.expect: drafting-partner recommends research-librarian to populate evidence-log.md with relevant EV- entries; the author invokes nfs-research to run it
